## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `outcome-distance-prior`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-26T06:05:19.670Z.

Catalog entry, slug "outcome-distance-prior" — strategic reachability as a first-class relevance signal. Recorded 2026-07-26 with a slug rather than an ordinal, because the ordinal space collided three times on 2026-07-25 (see the registry finding on pm-g8t7b9); slugs are the collision-free form that registry now requires.

Gap this closes. Every signal in the catalog to date scores a candidate by its relationship to the AGENT: how recently it was touched (activation), what it is associated with (spreading activation, structural fingerprints), what is unfinished (tension), what changes with it (co-change coupling), what the current intent is (task-set and model conditioning), what peers are already covering (fleet diversification). Not one entry scores a candidate by its relationship to the PROJECT'S DECLARED OUTCOMES. Two items can be identically recent, identically associated, and identically unfinished, while one of them is a direct precondition of a shipping outcome and the other advances nothing anyone has committed to. The scorer currently cannot tell those apart, and an agent asked to pick work would like it to.

Why the signal is newly available rather than newly imagined. It was not computable before 2026-07-26. The strategic layer of this workspace was wired almost entirely with the untyped `related` kind: the six outcome milestones carried between zero and five inbound typed edges, so `pm graph impact <milestone> --kind implements,verifies --direction incoming` returned 0 to 5 nodes and there was no distance to read. After the typed-ladder pass the same query returns 16 to 123 nodes per milestone at shortest-path distances of 1 to 5, with 268 of 271 active items reaching at least one outcome. The signal exists now because the graph now carries the meaning; that ordering matters, because the algorithm is worthless on a graph wired with untyped edges and would have looked like a good idea anyway.

Method.

1. Precompute, per outcome root, the shortest typed path length to every item over the semantic kind set (implements, verifies), in the write-time incremental fold that already maintains activation and sketches. This is a multi-source BFS over a sparse graph; on this workspace it costs one traversal of 4,877 edges and the result is a small integer per item per root.

2. Convert distance to a prior with a decay that is scale-free rather than tuned: prior(i) = max over roots r of exp(-lambda * d(i,r)), with lambda derived from the observed distance distribution rather than hardcoded, so a shallow project and a deep one both get a usable spread. Items that reach no outcome get the floor value, not zero - unreachable is a filing gap, not evidence of irrelevance, and zeroing it would hide exactly the items a graph-hygiene pass wants to surface.

3. Combine as a multiplicative prior on the existing linear score rather than as another additive term. The distinction is deliberate: outcome distance is not evidence that an item is relevant to the current task, it is evidence about how much the project cares. A multiplicative prior modulates the ranking the other signals produce without being able to promote an item the task-relevance signals rejected outright, which is the failure mode of adding strategic weight additively.

4. Carry the path, not just the number, into the explanation. The rationale string an agent reads becomes "2 hops from proven-scale via pm-9rxu" rather than "strategic prior 0.61". This keeps the truthfulness rule the catalog imposes on the linear scorer: every contribution must be renderable as a reason a human would accept.

Interaction with entries already in the catalog. Spreading activation propagates from what the agent is touching; this propagates from what the project has committed to. They are the two halves of the same graph read in opposite directions, and they should share one traversal rather than run two. The merge-probability provenance ranking entry conditions on which branch a fact came from; this conditions on which outcome a fact serves; both are edge-conditioned and both belong in the same edge-weighting pass. Fleet-joint diversification lifts packing from per-agent to per-fleet coverage of the relevant frontier - outcome distance is the natural definition of that frontier's boundary, so the two compose directly rather than competing.

Degeneracy requirement, per the catalog's standing rule. In a workspace with no milestones and no typed semantic edges - the three-item scratch project of pm-z436 - every item is at floor distance, the prior is a constant, and the multiplicative term is the identity. The small end pays nothing, which is the same bar every other entry in this catalog has had to meet.

Risk to record, because it is real and cuts against the entry. This signal rewards items that are well-wired and penalises items that are not, so it is only as honest as the graph's edge hygiene. A correctly-scoped item that nobody linked will rank below a marginal item that somebody linked well, and the scorer will look confidently wrong. Two existing items are the mitigation and this entry should not ship before them: pm-bzmeaa makes bounded outcome reachability an enforced invariant rather than an aspiration, so an unlinked item is a gate failure rather than a quietly demoted candidate; pm-4020c5 canonicalises the dependency-kind vocabulary, without which the semantic kind set is itself fragmenting and the traversal loses conductance to spelling drift. Recorded as a hard sequencing constraint rather than a caveat.

Owner: the scorer contract (pm-h3no) for the combination step; the signal feature store (pm-3hps) for the precomputed distances, since it already owns write-time incremental maintenance of exactly this shape. Dispositioned into the portfolio registry (pm-g8t7b9) by slug, not filed as a standalone item, per the catalog's standing rule.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.

The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented. Distinct objective: outcome distance prior.

Define a versioned public-SDK input/output and parameter contract, with exact source receipts and bounded time, memory and token complexity.; Implement an isolated reproducible prototype and compare held-out quality, task success, costs, cold-start behavior and negative controls against the unchanged baseline.; Record an accept, reject, or defer decision with evidence; production implementation requires an accepted decision and its own linked delivery scope.
A falsifiable decision on outcome distance prior with reusable benchmark evidence and no unreviewed production policy change.
